# Third-party libraries / 第三方依赖

本目录默认 **不包含 raylib 源码**，在线首次配置时 CMake 自动下载官方固定标签 `6.0`。学校断网时按 [`docs/QA.md`](../docs/QA.md) 中的离线方案，将官方完整 raylib 6.0 源码解压到 `third_party/raylib/`。

Please preserve raylib's original LICENSE and provenance when distributing its source. `third_party/raylib/` is ignored by Git to keep each student's coursework repository small.
